turns.q: Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
turns.replyText:
Hi Nora, I’m Nova AI, Fashion Nova’s AI customer care assistant. I’m not a human.

If you just placed an order and it hasn’t shipped yet, there’s sometimes a short window where the address may still be able to be updated, but I’ll need to pull up the order first to check what stage it’s in.

What’s the order number (or the 9-character confirmation code from the checkout page)?

turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyText:
Yes, sometimes, but only in a short window right after you place it while the order is still on hold.

After that window, if it hasn’t shipped yet, we can ask the care team to try to cancel it before it’s fulfilled, but it isn’t guaranteed. Once an order has shipped or been delivered, it can’t be canceled.

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyText:
No, items, sizes, colors, and quantities can’t be changed after checkout, so you can’t add an item to an existing order.

The workaround is to place a new order for the additional item. If you end up not wanting something from the original order, you can return it (if eligible) for store credit within 30 days of delivery.

turns.q: How do I update my contact or account details?
turns.replyText:
You can update most account details and saved addresses from your account:

- Profile info and saved addresses: [My Info](https://www.fashionnova.com/account/addresses)

If you mean changing your account login email, that’s done here: [Fashion Nova account profile](https://account.fashionnova.com/profile) (it sends a verification code to both the old and new email).
